title: Make root-execution participant revision writes delta-native
outcome: Root-execution mutations advance compact participant revisions from explicit typed deltas without re-deserializing the growing execution projection, while preserving fail-closed monotonicity and canonical projection binding.
acceptance: A project-scale regression bounds root-execution persistence cost as retained contribution history grows
Claim, evidence, checkpoint, handoff, release, disposal, and completion paths supply exact participant deltas
Tampered or omitted participant revisions cannot be healed by later legitimate mutations
disposal_reason: obsolete: filed against the completion-barrier/participant-revision design that was rejected and removed before landing (1d04b09 shipped the refusal-recompute fix without that machinery)
